articles.title: Justice Department Looks Into TV Networks Pausing Trump Pool Coverage
articles.summary: The Justice Department is investigating whether TV networks broke competition laws when they paused shared White House pool coverage of President Trump.

articles.title: Close House Race in Southwest Washington Could Help Decide Congress
articles.summary: A competitive House race in Washington state's 3rd District pits incumbent Democrat Marie Gluesenkamp Perez against Republican John Braun, with local jobs and tariffs in focus.

articles.title: MIT Professor Uses AI to Make Power-Hungry Data Centers More Efficient
articles.summary: MIT's Christina Delimitrou uses machine learning to run data centers more efficiently so they use less power as cloud demand grows.
